name: iam-blast-radius
//: Module-format marker ONLY. The shipped tool is vanilla ES-module JS/CSS/HTML served verbatim by Pelican (no build step, no dependencies). This file exists so every ESM loader resolves engine/*.js + app.js + worker.js as ESM explicitly, instead of relying on Node's auto module-syntax detection (which Playwright's loader does not perform, breaking e2e collection). It declares no dependencies and no scripts.
